WITH erf AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE kv.value WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') kv
  GROUP BY s."ART_link"
), cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS art_id,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
)
SELECT MAX(c.cpi * e.erf) AS max_avs FROM cpi c JOIN erf e ON e.art_id = c.art_id
note: ERF = average of the mapped ratings in env_handling_sensitivity->'environment' (light, humidity, vibration, pollutants, temperature), nulls ignored; the knowledge base does not say which sensitivity keys count

WITH yr AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::int AS year, AVG("TEMPc") AS avg_temp
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS") BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT y.year, ROUND(y.avg_temp, 2) AS avg_temperature,
       COUNT(e."TEMPc") FILTER (WHERE ABS(e."TEMPc" - y.avg_temp) > 0 AND ABS(e."TEMPc" - y.avg_temp) <= 4) AS anomaly_count
FROM yr y JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."readTS")::int = y.year
GROUP BY y.year, y.avg_temp
ORDER BY y.year
note: Counts each reading row as a daily reading; years with no data (2023) do not appear

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS registry_number, a.art_title AS title, a."MatKind" AS material_type,
       s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS humidity_sensitivity,
       CASE WHEN (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'High' AND e."RH" > 55)
              OR (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'Medium' AND e."RH" > 60)
            THEN 'Over Exposure' ELSE 'Within Limits' END AS exposure_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
WHERE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' IN ('Medium','High')
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"
note: The 'secondary, more cautious' threshold is taken as the Humidity Exposure Thresholds (High > 55% RH, Medium > 60% RH); the knowledge base defines no other humidity threshold. RH comes from readings of the artifact's assessed showcase

answer:
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, ra.risk_level,
       r."HIST_sign" AS historical_significance, (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ra.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
WHERE ra.risk_level IN ('High','Medium')
  AND r."HIST_sign" > 8 AND (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric > 20

SELECT a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
       ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
        * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score,
       cm.budget_alloc AS budget_allocation,
       cm.budget_stat AS budget_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = ca.case_exam
JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = e.monitor_code
WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL
note: 'Generalized budget status' is taken as the budget_stat column and 'specific allocation' as budget_alloc. Path: artifact -> ConditionAssessments showcase -> readings -> ConservationAndMaintenance

WITH erf AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE kv.value WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf,
         jsonb_object_agg(kv.key, kv.value) FILTER (WHERE kv.value = 'High') AS high_sensitivities
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') kv
  GROUP BY s."ART_link"
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name, e.erf AS erf_score,
       COALESCE(e.high_sensitivities, '{}'::jsonb) AS high_sensitivity_summary
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN erf e ON e.art_id = a."ARTregID"
WHERE e.erf > 4
ORDER BY e.erf DESC
note: ERF and the High summary both use the environment sensitivity keys

WITH c AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming','Qing')
)
SELECT artifact_id, title, dynasty, cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi_score > 7 THEN 'High Priority' WHEN cpi_score > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority' ELSE 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM c
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC

WITH sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE kv.value WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE kv.value = 'High') AS high_count
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') kv
  GROUP BY s."ART_link"
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name,
       e."TEMPc" AS temperature, e."RH" AS humidity,
       COALESCE(s.high_count, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN (a."ageYears" * s.erf * POWER(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc") / 100000.0 > 5
             AND COALESCE(s.high_count, 0) >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN sens s ON s.art_id = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT er."TEMPc", er."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" ca
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" er ON er.case_link = ca.case_exam
  WHERE ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
  ORDER BY er."readTS" DESC
  LIMIT 1
) e ON TRUE
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"
note: Current conditions = latest reading for the showcase(s) the artifact was assessed in

answer:
SELECT DISTINCT case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
WHERE case_link IS NOT NULL AND ("tempVar24" > 1 OR "RHvar" > 3)
ORDER BY case_link

SELECT s."caseID" AS showcase_id
FROM "Showcases" s
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e
        WHERE e.case_link = s."caseID"
          AND 10 - ((e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0 + (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3.0) < 5)
   OR ( (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) >= 3
ORDER BY s."caseID"
